aibatcheditor-desc: Batch-edit pages with AI assistance for wikilinks, spellcheck, formatting, and writing style, with preview-before-save.
aibatcheditor-summary: Select pages and AI operations, preview each change as a diff, then approve before saving.
aibatcheditor-permission-denied: You do not have permission to use the AI Batch Editor. The "$1" right is required.
aibatcheditor-nojs: The AI Batch Editor requires JavaScript to be enabled.
right-aibatchedit: Use the AI Batch Editor to run AI-assisted batch edits
aibatcheditor-error-no-input: Provide either a list of titles or a category name.
aibatcheditor-error-no-titles: No pages were found for the given input.
aibatcheditor-error-batch-too-large: The batch contains $1 pages, but the maximum allowed is $2.
aibatcheditor-error-operation-disabled: The operation "$1" is disabled on this wiki.
aibatcheditor-error-llm-not-configured: The AI endpoint is not configured. Set $wgAIBatchEditorApiUrl and $wgAIBatchEditorApiKey in LocalSettings.php.
aibatcheditor-error-llm-invalid-response: The AI returned an invalid response.
aibatcheditor-error-llm-empty-response: The AI returned an empty response.
aibatcheditor-error-rate-limit: Hourly AI limit reached ($2 of $1 requests used). Try again later.
aibatcheditor-error-custom-needs-instruc: The custom operation requires AI instructions.
aibatcheditor-error-page-too-large: Page is too large for AI processing ($1 bytes; limit is $2).
aibatcheditor-error-instructions-too-lon: AI instructions are too long ($1 bytes; limit is $2).
aibatcheditor-error-diff-too-large: Diff text exceeds the maximum allowed size ($1 bytes per side).
aibatcheditor-error-edits-payload-too-la: The submitted edits payload is too large ($1 bytes; limit is $2).
aibatcheditor-error-save-proposed-too-la: Proposed wikitext is too large ($1 bytes; limit is $2).
aibatcheditor-error-save-not-wikitext: Cannot save: the page does not use wikitext.
aibatcheditor-ui-page-instructions-place: Override batch instructions for this page
apihelp-aibatcheditorlist-summary: Validate and list pages for AI batch editing.
apihelp-aibatcheditorlist-param-titles: Pipe- or newline-separated list of page titles.
apihelp-aibatcheditorlist-param-prefix: Optional title prefix filter when listing category members.
apihelp-aibatcheditorlist-example-2: List pages in a category with a title prefix.
apihelp-aibatcheditorprocess-summary: Run an AI operation on a batch of pages.
apihelp-aibatcheditorprocess-param-title: Pipe- or newline-separated list of page titles.
apihelp-aibatcheditorprocess-param-prefi: Optional title prefix filter when listing category members.
apihelp-aibatcheditorprocess-param-opera: AI operation to run: wikilinks, spellcheck, formatting, or style.
apihelp-aibatcheditorprocess-param-profi: Aggressiveness profile: conservative, balanced, or aggressive.
apihelp-aibatcheditorprocess-param-instr: Optional custom instructions sent to the AI for each page.
apihelp-aibatcheditorprocess-param-summa: Optional edit summary for the batch (used when saving).
apihelp-aibatcheditorprocess-example-1: Run spellcheck on the main page with a conservative profile.
aibatcheditor-ui-step-pages-desc: Enter page titles or choose a category, then validate which pages are editable.
aibatcheditor-ui-step-operation-desc: Choose an operation, aggressiveness profile, and the edit summary used when saving.
aibatcheditor-ui-step-results-desc: Preview each proposed change, approve the ones you want, then save them to the wiki.
aibatcheditor-ui-titles-placeholder: One title per line, or separated by |
aibatcheditor-ui-titles-help: One title per line, or separated by |.
aibatcheditor-ui-prefix-help: Only include category members whose title starts with this prefix.
aibatcheditor-ui-profile-help: How aggressively the AI should edit. Configure per-operation text in $wgAIBatchEditorOperationProfiles.
aibatcheditor-ui-instructions-placeholde: e.g. Add this date as married couple on each page
aibatcheditor-ui-instructions-help: Custom directions sent to the AI for every page in the batch. This is not the wiki edit summary.
aibatcheditor-ui-summary-placeholder: Describe this batch edit for the page history
aibatcheditor-ui-summary-help: Recorded in the wiki history when you save approved changes.
aibatcheditor-ui-no-valid-pages: No editable pages were found for this input.
aibatcheditor-ui-too-large-skipped: $1 {{PLURAL:$1|page|pages}} skipped because they exceed the size limit ($2 bytes).
aibatcheditor-page-error-too-large: Too large for AI ($1 bytes; limit $2)
aibatcheditor-page-error-not-readable: You do not have permission to read this page
apihelp-aibatcheditordiff-summary: Render a wikitext diff for batch preview.
apihelp-aibatcheditordiff-param-title: Optional page title for diff headers.
apihelp-aibatcheditordiff-example-1: Render a diff between two wikitext strings.
aibatcheditor-error-save-not-exists: Cannot save: page does not exist.
aibatcheditor-error-save-redirect: Cannot save: page is a redirect.
aibatcheditor-error-save-not-editable: Cannot save: you do not have permission to edit this page.
aibatcheditor-error-save-conflict: Cannot save: the page was edited by someone else. Re-run the batch and try again.
aibatcheditor-error-save-missing-summary: Provide an edit summary before saving.
aibatcheditor-error-save-no-edits: No edits were submitted to save.
aibatcheditor-error-save-invalid-json: The submitted edits payload is not valid.
aibatcheditor-ui-save-none-selected: Select at least one change to save.
aibatcheditor-ui-save-summary-required: Enter an edit summary before saving.
tag-aibatcheditor-description: Edit made through the AI Batch Editor extension
apihelp-aibatcheditorsave-summary: Save approved AI-proposed edits to the wiki.
apihelp-aibatcheditorsave-param-summary: Edit summary applied to each saved page.
apihelp-aibatcheditorsave-param-edits: JSON array of edits. Each object must include title, revid, and proposed wikitext.
apihelp-aibatcheditorsave-example-1: Save one approved edit with a summary.
